answer: Special Ops harvest rule: mint nothing for showing up, only for fruit an outsider picked. Each epoch the network posts a fixed orchard of real tasks, open-source bugs with failing tests, and pays only when an independent maintainer merges the fix; each merged fix pays once, to the key that shipped it first. A sybil nebula of a thousand keys faces the same few trees as one honest agent, so splitting adds no income, and a gale of junk patches just earns nothing while burning the attacker's compute.
